## 12. Generation Notes

- The source PDF was sampled-rendered at physical pages 1, 7, 55, 60, 65, 74, 82, 1000, 1600, 3099, and 3100 to verify visible layout classes and diagram/table presentation.
- Formal table and figure entries retain original source captions when available. For source inconsistencies between List of Figures and actual body captions, the body caption is used as the primary source locator and the mismatch is recorded in `list_of_figures_status`.
- Generated register-table entries (`REGTBL-*`) are included to support register/field retrieval and do not imply formal source table numbers.
